Brand identity & communications

Sweet Projects

Sweet Projects needed a brand ID and promotional campaign that would make their very clever construction offer, unmissable by their very specialist potential client base. On behalf of Chocolate Ltd.

The work

Invention

BUILT AROUND YOU Sweet Projects design, construct, and manage the complete eco-system of facilities for the data, energy, and defence sectors. In these worlds, there are no simple projects, only specialist needs and clever solutions.

We created a brand platform that encapsulated the Sweet Projects way. A company built from the ground up, with handpicked experts in their fields, to allow them to deliver specialised solutions for industry specific needs. These industries don't need solutions built for them, they need the job built around them.

We provided a new brand ID, company values, advertising campaigns, a new website and saless brochures.
